parsed.summary: The proposed patch introduces a new method `world_to_pixel` in `HighLevelWCSWrapper` to handle world to pixel transformations, including adjustments for sliced WCS. The patch seems to address the issue reported.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new method `world_to_pixel` which slightly deviates from the existing method naming conventions in the class.
The patch could be improved for readability by adding comments explaining the purpose of the new method and the logic within it.
